answer.rationale: The 14-day expiry, no auto-renewal, and zero production buffer make continuity the binding constraint. Prior incumbent renewals preserved delivery stability, while the prior low-cost switch showed savings and quick onboarding but does not yet establish that a new vendor can assume 94% committed volume without added delivery risk. Verify both records before committing; the renewal protects operations but leaves the mandated 18% spend reduction unresolved.
